links.outcome: Radiologist performance with versus without AI assistance in reader study
links.effect: With WAUVE assistance, average specificity of four radiologists improved by 6.67% and consistency rose from 0.807 to 0.838.
links.quote: With the WAUVE model assistance, the average specificity of four experienced radiologists was improved by 6.67%, and higher consistency was achieved (from 0.807 to 0.838).

links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance compared with radiologists and alternative models on same data
links.effect: WAUVE outperformed 2D-ResNet50, was similar to TimeSformer, and was comparable to four radiologists (sensitivity 97.39% vs 98.48%, specificity 49.33% vs 50.00%, accuracy 78.42% vs 79.34%).
links.quote: The WAUVE demonstrated superior performance compared to the 2D-ResNet50 model, while similar to the TimeSformer model.

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study with four radiologists comparing diagnostic performance with and without AI assistance.

primary.practice: AI assistance in radiologist reader study
